description.value:
A simple device used to provide life-saving oxygen.

"Breathe in, breathe out. You'll be fine."

D&D 5e Effect

As an action, a creature can consume or administer this item. A creature at 0 hit points regains 2d4 + 2 hit points. This cannot restore a dead creature.

GM Description — Original HSR Effect

Upon use, immediately heals one downed character for 10% of the character's Max HP.
